group7.name: Modify and Edit
flags: mirror_elements with createCopy:true returns source IDs — Revit's MirrorElements doesn't hand back copy IDs
copy_elements_to_level applies one Z-translation to whole set aligned by first element's level elevation — mixed-level selections shift together, does not reassign level parameter
set_element_parameters matches by name via LookupParameter (first match), converts Length=mm / Angle=deg / Yes-No=bool; read-only/unknown/failed go to skipped with reason

group8.name: Views, Sheets and Sheet Audit
flags: create_section_view — orientation hardcoded: looks along +Y (view right=X, up=Z), centered on bbox, extents clamped to ≥100mm. Riskiest handler — verify orientation first
set_view_crop_region — min/max applied in crop box local X/Y keeping existing Z; approximate for rotated views

compare_sheet_to_template — view-type matching is whitespace/case-insensitive. minimumDimensions and requireAllElementsTagged aggregate across all views on sheet. Title-block/view-type/count failures = error; annotation/tag/text shortfalls = warning. Untagged samples capped at 50 issues
get_sheet_contents — reads title block as first OST_TitleBlocks instance on sheet; tags report first tagged element ID
create_sheet with no titleBlockTypeId creates sheet without title block — titleBlockParameters will be empty in audits
